card.name: Sentence starts after a warning statement
card.fires_on: The first word (The, This, In) of a new sentence right after a sentence stating a serious adverse effect in a boxed warning or Warnings section. Also fires on a few words ending such warnings, like death or risk.

modes.label: Sentence opener after risk statement
modes.description: The, This or In starting the sentence that follows a stated serious adverse event.
modes.example: Tendinitis and tendon rupture can occur bilaterally.<< The>> risk of developing fluoroquinolone

modes.label: End of warning phrase
modes.description: Words like death or risk, or 'and' in cross-reference lists, that close a warning clause.
modes.example: serious infections that may lead to hospitalization or<< death>> [see Warnings and Precautions

card.plain: It marks the point right after a safety warning sentence where the next sentence begins, often giving details about timing or frequency of the risk.
